name: Hime to Majin to Koi Suru Tamashii
original_name: ヒメと魔神と恋するたましぃ
source:
During the Heian Era, the queen of the demon world sent her two daughters Kaguya and Sakuya to the human world for training, with the one with better results becoming the successor to the throne. Kaguya used her power to make humans suffer, while Sakuya blended in with the humans to control them from within. However, Sakuya fell in love with an onmyouji and thought that living in the human world isn’t that bad. She then received a request: to eliminate her older sister Kaguya. With the help of her lover, she successfully sealed Kaguya and brought peace to the land. However, her lover soon passed away due to illness and she returned to the demon world. Thousands of years later, Sakuya will be crowned the new queen, but she must marry someone. There is only one person in her heart, so she heads back to the human world to seek her reborn lover.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
平安時代，魔界女王把兩個女兒輝夜與咲夜送到人界修行，表現較好的人可以繼承王位。輝夜用力量令人類受苦，咲夜則融入人群，試圖從內部控制人類。然而，咲夜愛上了一名陰陽師，並覺得在人界生活也沒有那麼糟糕。隨後，她接到一項任務：消滅姊姊輝夜。在愛人幫助下，她成功封印輝夜，為大地帶來和平。可是戀人不久後便因病過世，咲夜也返回魔界。數千年後，咲夜即將加冕為新女王，卻必須先與某人結婚。她心中只有一個人，於是重返人界，尋找轉世後的愛人。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/05/15/may-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
